blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The International Criminal Court (ICC) Registry has amended its E-Court Protocol in the case of former President Rodrigo Duterte to include a URL metadata field for open-source evidence to be presented by prosecutors. The move follows a Sept. 28 order by Trial Chamber III granting the prosecution’s request to add the field to Niux Discover, the court’s system for storing and reviewing evidence. The Registry submitted the amended protocol on Oct. 1, saying it was acting on the chamber’s order.
